name: product-toolkit
description: Personal Claude Code skills library — reusable slash commands for shipping production-grade products fast.
author: kish21

commands.purpose: Scaffold a complete production-ready project foundation
Audit any AI project for production readiness across 8 categories
End-of-phase quality gate before pushing to remote
Grade existing docs against the bar an external reader would actually apply
Scaffold ONE new doc grounded in actual code state
Build production-grade frontend interfaces avoiding generic AI aesthetics
Create a React component following design system rules
Audit finished UI against 12 AI-tell checks before delivery
Apply visual themes to any artifact
Standard GitHub branch → PR → CI → merge workflow
Guide for building high-quality MCP servers (Python or TypeScript)
Build new skills, improve existing skills, run skill evals

notes: This manifest is forward-compatible. When Anthropic ships an official Claude Code plugin manifest standard, the upgrade should be mechanical.
Each command file has YAML frontmatter (name, description) so it self-identifies on disk.
Distribution model: fork + one-liner install. No marketplace dependency.
